sources.title: Chargers hiring former MIA, NYG HC Adam Gase as offensive assistant
sources.description: The Chargers are bringing in a familiar face to NFL fans they may not have seen for quite some time. After half a decade away from coaching, former Dolphins and Jets head coach Adam Gase is joining the Chargers staff as an offensive assistant who will be working with their pass game.
